sources.selection_policy: Select conservative primary headwords, kana synonym surfaces only when the normalized surface exactly equals the explicit reading, and IROHA-local suru forms from explicitly sahen-tagged headwords. No inflections are generated from kana synonyms. Do not import source context IDs, costs, source tags, pronunciation, or IPA dictionary analysis results. The official source states that its dictionary entries are based on the IPA dictionary; no UniDic/Mozc source is used and no MeCab runtime dependency is added.

candidate_selection_policy: Selected the top 6,000,000 unique rows from 10,470,706 candidates. Selection order prioritizes lexical rows, proper names and productive suru forms, then regular inflections and one-auxiliary compounds. Within each class, ranking uses source priority tags and IROHA-local heuristics. No double-auxiliary fallback was used. Later source supplements are appended only after source-specific licensing/provenance audit; the 2026-11-28 JST and NINJAL additions are documented in verified_source_expansion.json and their row-level attribution tables.

supplement_selection_policy: Append all valid Japanese WordNet v2.1 lemma/POS/reading rows absent from the base release. For explicit sahen notes, add the verbal-noun lemma, the corresponding suru form, and forms generated by the existing IROHA-local suru rules. Skip entries whose available sense confidence scores are all below 0.7. No base rows are removed or reordered.

Row-level NAIST source lines are in NAIST-ATTRIBUTION.tsv; Wiktionary source pages remain in their attribution TSVs. Wikidata Japanese Lexeme structured data is CC0 1.0; entity-level IDs are retained in WIKIDATA-ATTRIBUTION.tsv. wiktionary_selection_policy: Only Japanese-language entries with POS noun, at least one nonempty gloss, exactly one unique kana reading in forms tagged transliteration, and a Japanese-script surface. No inference, multiple-reading choice, gloss, or example is imported; exact existing rows are skipped.
wiktionary_broad_selection_policy: Select mapped Japanese parts of speech only when at least one gloss and explicit kana transliteration are present. Keep all distinct explicit kana readings. Do not import glosses or examples. For verb entries, use a canonical surface associated with the lemma and generate IROHA-local conjugations/one auxiliary only for explicit suru forms. For i/na-adjectives, add only source-listed inflection forms under conservative stem/suffix checks. Skip rows already present by exact reading/surface/POS key; retain per-row page URLs in attribution TSV.
naist_jdic_selection_policy: Read only NAIST-JDIC 0.6.3.b-20111013 naist-jdic.csv from the pinned Debian source archive. Use CSV surface (column 0), explicit reading (column 11), selected POS (columns 4-6), and base-form conjugation metadata (columns 8-10). Do not import non-base verb/adjective forms as standalone candidates, including connective stems; generate inflections only for explicitly mapped modern conjugation types using IROHA-local rules. Generate suru forms only for rows explicitly tagged 名詞/サ変接続. Do not import source connection IDs, source costs, pronunciation (column 12), or any UniDic data. Skip rows already present by exact reading/surface/IROHA-POS key and retain source row numbers.

wikidata_selection_policy: Japanese Wikidata Lexeme entities only; curated lexical-category QIDs mapped to IROHA-local POS IDs; explicit ja and ja-hira representations from the same lemma/form are paired; for inflecting POS, unlabelled forms must match a lemma reading; feature-tagged forms are accepted only for reviewed standalone dictionary, attributive, or imperative forms; nonstandalone, unknown, malformed, and unsupported feature combinations are rejected; no source IDs/costs imported. Exact rows already in the base dictionary are omitted.
wiktionary_extended_selection_policy: Use Japanese Wiktionary entries outside the already-added noun subset only when one explicit kana transliteration and a nonempty gloss exist. POS must be in the reviewed mapping. Verb written forms use explicit canonical forms; mismatched sahen headwords are skipped. Only suru inflections are generated with IROHA-local rules. Character entries require an explicit form_of link matching the reading and an attested mapped POS. No reading is inferred; row-level Wiktionary page URLs are appended to WIKTIONARY-ATTRIBUTION.tsv.
ninjal_edu_selection_policy: Read only the official NINJAL Database of Basic Vocabulary in Education Version 2009B CSV. Use the explicit kana 見出し as reading; use a single plain Japanese 表記 only when no annotation, alternative separator, or Latin-only spelling is present, otherwise retain the headword as kana surface. Map only explicit and reviewed POS tokens to IROHA-local classes. Generate modern verb inflections only for an exact single 五段/上一段/下一段/サ変/カ変 label with matching reading ending; generate i-adjective forms only for 形 entries that end in い, except irregular いい; generate する compounds only where a separate ス自/ス他/ス自他 marker is explicit. Unmapped-only labels are skipped; classical and irregular categories remain lexical-only or are skipped. Do not import source frequency, distribution, semantic classification numbers, source POS IDs, or source costs. Assign IROHA-local IDs and costs; keep all source references outside dictionary entries. No UniDic or Mozc data or runtime dependency is used.
ninjal_japanese_education_selection_poli: Read only the official NINJAL Database of Basic Vocabulary in Japanese Language Education six-list CSV. Use the explicit kana 見出し as reading; use a single plain Japanese 表記 only when no annotation, alternative separator, or Latin-only spelling is present, otherwise retain the headword as kana surface. Map only explicit and reviewed POS tokens to IROHA-local classes. Do not use list-membership columns, vocabulary allocation, word origin, category codes, source costs, or rankings. Generate modern inflections only for an exact single reviewed conjugation label; generate する compounds only for explicit suru markers. Keep all source references outside dictionary entries; omit rows already present by exact reading/surface/POS key.

ipadic_selection_policy: Read only top-level CSV entries from the pinned official IPADIC 2.7.0-20070801 archive. Use surface (column 0), selected POS (columns 4-7), explicit reading (column 11), and conjugation/base-form metadata (columns 8-10). Do not import source left/right IDs, source costs, pronunciation (column 12), unknown-word model data, or MeCab runtime code. Generate modern forms and suru compounds only with the reviewed IROHA-local rules. Exclude source rows whose spelling conflicts with base readings, proper-noun POS rows, and Latin-letter surfaces; exclude generated candidates that conflict by spelling/reading; do not generate contracted causative-passive forms for five-row s-verbs. Skip rows already present by exact reading/surface/IROHA-POS key. Keep source file and line references outside dictionary rows. No UniDic or Mozc data or runtime dependency is used.

verified_source_expansion.pos_id_policy: IROHA-local IDs only; left_id and right_id both map to the IROHA POS class

japanpost_expansion.selection_policy: Use only explicit Japan Post katakana readings and corresponding prefecture/municipality/town-area written fields; convert kana deterministically to hiragana, keep only readings composed exclusively of kana and kana marks, exclude generic/non-specific placeholders, assign IROHA-local proper_noun ID 18, add no guessed readings or inflections, keep provenance out of dictionary rows.

ndl_expansion.selection_policy: Use only a single NDL subject/genre-form heading with an explicit katakana transcription; remove source spaces deterministically and convert katakana to hiragana; exclude subdivisions, annotated headings and readings containing non-katakana text; generate no inflections; keep record IDs and source references in a separate attribution TSV.
ndl_expansion.pos_mapping: NDL subject or genre/form heading mapped to IROHA noun (ID 1); source does not provide a morphological part-of-speech field
